dedupe_keys.name: hill of towie wind farm open dataset

description: The Hill of Towie wind farm open dataset gives more than ten years of operational data from a commercial 21-turbine wind farm in Scotland. It is released by the renewable energy company RES on behalf of the owner TRIG, with version 2.1.0 published on Zenodo in September 2026 by Alex Clerc and Elizabeth Lingkan. It holds turbine metadata for the 21 Siemens SWT-2.3-VS-82 turbines (coordinates, rated power, rotor diameter, hub height); 10-minute SCADA statistics and alarm logs by year from January 2016 to April 2026, taken from the Siemens SCADA backup with only anonymising columns dropped; downtime per turbine and 10 minutes from SCADA and operator logs; roughly 1 Hz turbine and yaw controller data and lidar data for January to April 2026; and dates of blade and control upgrades (AeroUp, TuneUp and a Dynamic Yaw campaign that toggled control on and off). Coverage is one wind farm in Scotland. Files are yearly zipped CSV archives of about 1.4 to 1.6 GB, with a data dictionary and changelog, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: it is one site, and upgrade campaigns change turbine behaviour within the record. Simulation uses are wind farm performance, downtime and failure analysis, wake control studies and validating energy yield models. Related records: data-kelmarsh-wind-farm-scada and data-penmanshiel-wind-farm-scada are other open UK wind farm data sets.
